headline: 2' glassy and offshore — morning glass at Picnic Tables! Get out there.
text: 7 AM high tide check at Cocoa Beach's best surf spot — 2 foot and glassy breaking nearshore with SW offshore winds grooming it clean. This is what we've been waiting for all week. Conditions are prime for a fun longboard session or a shortboard if you can find a steep one. Offshore winds holding the faces up nicely. Grab your board and get out here before the wind switches. This is the morning we told you about.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Wednesday April 30, 2026 | 2ft Glassy, SW Offshore Winds
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report Wednesday April 30: 2ft glassy surf breaking nearshore with SW offshore winds at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Clean morning conditions — get out there!

headline: 2'+ choppy but workable for a longboard. Larger swell filling in tonight!
text: 8:15 AM outgoing tide check at Cocoa Beach's best surf spot — 2 foot plus breaking nearshore with ENE onshore winds chopping it up. Workable for a longboard if you're itching to paddle out. The good news: reports are showing a larger period swell filling in this evening with better winds coming tomorrow and Thursday. Could be a fun midweek run. Stay tuned.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Tuesday April 28, 2026 | 2ft+ Choppy, Swell Building Tonight
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report Tuesday April 28: 2ft+ breaking nearshore with ENE onshore chop at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Longboard workable. Larger period swell filling in tonight with better winds Wednesday and Thursday.

headline: 2-3' choppy NE onshore — barely enough to make a board go. Tomorrow may be surfable.
text: 5:25 PM high tide check at Cocoa Beach's best surf spot — 2-3 foot and choppy with NE onshore winds making it bumpy and barely enough to push a board. Not the session you're looking for today. Good news is tomorrow's forecast is looking more surfable so we'll be back at first light to check. Stay tuned.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Monday April 27, 2026 | 2-3ft Choppy NE Onshore
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report Monday April 27: 2-3ft choppy with NE onshore winds at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Not worth the paddle. Better conditions expected Tuesday.

headline: 1-2' clean lines — longboard fun at first light before the wind fills in.
text: 7 AM outgoing tide check at Cocoa Beach's best surf spot — 1-2 foot clean lines breaking nearshore with light variable winds keeping things smooth. Fun longboard session if you get out early before the onshore fills in. Small but surfable. Enjoy the Monday morning glass. Stay tuned for an afternoon update.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Monday April 27, 2026 | 1-2ft Clean Morning Lines
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report Monday April 27 morning: 1-2ft clean lines at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Light winds and fun longboard conditions at first light.

headline: 1-2' with NE onshore bumps — rideable but not pretty. High tide incoming, fast drift conditions.
text: Noon high tide check at Cocoa Beach's best surf spot — 1-2 foot with NE onshore winds adding texture and a strong south-to-north drift. Rideable on a longboard if you don't mind the bump. Watch the current — it's pulling hard today. Stay tuned.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Saturday April 26, 2026 | 1-2ft NE Onshore, Drift Advisory
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report Saturday April 26: 1-2ft with NE onshore bumps at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Rideable longboard session with strong drift. High tide incoming.

headline: 1' onshore mush — ESE winds killing it at Picnic Tables. Check back tomorrow morning.
text: Afternoon check at Cocoa Beach's best surf spot and conditions aren't doing us any favors right now. 1 foot breaking nearshore with onshore ESE winds making it messy and blown out. Not worth paddling out. We'll be back at first light tomorrow when winds typically go offshore — morning glass is always the move. Stay tuned.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Saturday April 25, 2026 | Onshore ESE, 1ft Nearshore
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report for Saturday April 25: 1 foot nearshore surf with onshore ESE winds at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Conditions poor. Checking again Sunday morning for better winds.

headline: 1-2' clean with fun sets. Aloha Friday — grab your longboard!
text: 8 AM low tide check — 1-2' breaking nearshore but some very fun sets coming through. Light offshore winds keeping the faces clean and glassy. Perfect longboard morning at Picnic Tables. Aloha Friday — get out there and enjoy it before the wind shifts. Stay tuned for an afternoon update.
seoTitle: Cocoa Beach Surf Report — Friday April 24, 2026 | 1-2ft Clean Fun Sets, Offshore Morning
seoDescription: Cocoa Beach surf report Friday April 24: 1-2ft clean surf with fun sets at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. Light offshore winds and glassy conditions. Grab your longboard!
